payload.absent_from_searched_list: floor below the last listed value; not searched: missing

fitted_score.cv: 3 folds grouped by search group, inside train
fitted_score.form: pairwise logistic, linear in standardised measures and missing flags
fitted_score.pairs: top 50 and straddle 50 pairs of training pages

baselines: persistence (position on the input page, NT50 when absent)
forecaster.rows: site in the top 100 of the input or outcome page, both pages at least 50 deep
forecaster.test: test searches, input page on or after the cutoff
forecaster.train: train searches, outcome before the cutoff

payload.gate_test: rows in 1 to 10 (positive) against 51 to 100 (negative) on test pages of depth at least 90; score = strength minus the median of the page's other top-10 sites; AUC
payload.name: strength

pages.test_pages: test searches dated on or after the cutoff
pages.train_pages: train searches dated before the cutoff

payload.ties: a missing or equal value scores 0.5; right, wrong and tied are reported apart

topical.combination: score + beta * topical, beta by pairwise logistic on training pages
topical.history: pages strictly before the page, other searches, same locale; train rows see train searches only
topical.k: method of moments on training rows
topical.test: top 50 and straddle 10 pairs on test pages, score alone against score plus topical
